title: 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵
pinyin: Huáng Hè Lóu Sòng Mèng Hào Rán Zhī Guǎng Líng
englishTitle: Seeing Meng Haoran Off at Yellow Crane Tower
author: Li Bai

translation: My old friend leaves Yellow Crane Tower, heading west no more
In the misty blossoms of March, he sails down to Yangzhou
A lone sail, a distant shadow, vanishing into blue sky
All I see is the Yangtze, flowing to the edge of heaven

annotations.故人: old friend — Meng Haoran, a senior poet Li Bai deeply admired
annotations.烟花: misty blossoms — the hazy bloom of late spring, not fireworks
annotations.下: to go downstream, to travel down to
annotations.碧空尽: to vanish at the end of the blue sky
annotations.唯见: only see — the speaker keeps watching long after the boat is gone

appreciation: A farewell poem where the goodbye is never spoken. Li Bai just stands there, watching his friend's sail shrink to a dot and disappear, until nothing is left but the river. The camera keeps rolling after the subject has left the frame — and that lingering shot is the friendship.
